thief.desc: Fast Hands: drink potions as a Bonus Action; +1 speed.

shadowblade.name: Shadowblade
shadowblade.desc: Hide lasts longer and your first strike from hiding auto-crits.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.desc: Raging zaps nearby foes for 1d6 lightning.

beastwarden.name: Beastwarden
beastwarden.desc: A wolf companion fights beside you.

lore.name: College of Lore
lore.desc: Cutting Words also works on damage.

vengeance.name: Oath of Vengeance
vengeance.desc: Smite marks the target; advantage against it.

fiend_pact.name: Fiend Patron
fiend_pact.desc: Dark One's Blessing: temp HP on kills.

hollow_pact.name: Hollow Patron
hollow_pact.desc: Eldritch blasts chain to a second foe.

land.name: Circle of the Land
land.desc: Natural Recovery: Entangle also heals allies inside.

moon.name: Moonsworn
moon.desc: +2 AC and claws (1d8) instead of flame.
